title: Migrate Runtime binding and deployment mode routes
summary_zh: 將 RuntimeBinding 與 deployment-mode 的十七個 BFF route decorators 移入可注入的 runtime router；保留 Runtime Manager 的 RuntimeBinding 寫入權限與現有 deployment/binding 語意。

replacement_lineage.reason: 功能範圍不變；V2 僅將已完成的 target-repository bootstrap dependency 與 immutable review-manifest contract 綁定。

owned: RuntimeBinding BFF endpoint ownership and BFF-only dependency injection
flat BFF route composition that preserves the established runtime route inventory
late-bound BFF read-store resolution and Runtime route ownership tests
not_changing: Runtime Manager loader or RuntimeBinding write authority
DeploymentPlan, governance approval, or Capital Pool write contracts

contracts.router_ownership: All seventeen RuntimeBinding, runtime-state, paper/live drift, runtime SSE, runtime BFF, and v5 execution-health GET/POST endpoints are registered by create_runtime_router; main.py contains none of their @app route decorators.
contracts.composition: main.py supplies its existing BFF ports to create_runtime_router and extends app.routes with the router routes. The flat registration preserves direct route inventory and OpenAPI behavior without a reverse import from runtime/ to main.py.
contracts.runtime_authority: The extraction does not add a RuntimeBinding write path outside Runtime Manager. Binding remains governance/capital-owned and RuntimeBinding deployment_mode remains the actual runtime stage.
contracts.request_injection: The legacy runtime-action deprecation endpoint retains FastAPI Request injection, so Request is not exposed as an accidental required query parameter.

verification.details: py_compile passed; runtime router ownership and request-injection suite passed 4/4; v5 BFF endpoint and direct-handler suite passed 14/14; the runtime template is present in the flat route inventory (1/1 selected path-dedupe test); git diff --check passed.

diagnostic_non_gate.reason: The two unrelated deprecated-path assertions expect body.error while origin/dev's unchanged _deprecated_bff_path_response returns body.detail.error. The runtime inventory assertion passes after this extraction.
diagnostic_non_gate.source_basis: origin/dev:services/control-plane/bff/main.py contains the same deprecated response envelope.
